Exchanges.Text:
Hi Gate team-c team.  

Our sprint goal is “Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically,” and there are 6 days left in the sprint.
Sure thing—I'll ask Daniel for an update now.

Daniel, quick update: is the story 3 summary page done, is story 4 task 19 done, and is task 15 done? Also, did you flag task 19 if it slipped, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12, the Sandbox gateway timeouts on retry?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.
Daniel, I noted your commitment: you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests today.
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
Noted, Daniel. You’re saying that’s everything from you today, and nothing is blocking you.
Okay, let’s switch focus to the next member. I’ll invite Maya to give her update now.

Thanks, Daniel.  

Maya, quick check: is your “I’ll chase them today” item for story 5 done, is “pair with him on staging access today” for bug 12 done, is continuing settlement file validation for story 2 done, and is the settlement schema review from task 16 done?  

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let’s take that offline; I’ll add it to the parking lot. Maya, please carry on with your update, especially the settlement file validation and any next steps you’ll take.
That's everything from me.
Maya, who can help unblock this, especially with access to the platform team staging gateway and the sandbox gateway timeouts?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.
Okay, let me share what I’ve noted from your update.
Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.
Thanks, Maya. I’ll hand the floor back and keep it short.
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.
Noted, Admin: keep working on the payment retry story today. No blockers were mentioned.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Team, we’re ending with one blocker: access to the platform team staging gateway is still pending.  

Topics to circle back on offline include the side discussion about gateway timeouts with Daniel Park and Admin, and follow-ups will go in Teams.  

Items not covered in today’s updates are task 19, task 15, and story 5, and their owners will receive follow-ups in Teams.  

Thanks, everyone.
